blocks.text: If the verb of a sentence is transitive, the idea may be expressed in two ways: if we want to emphasize the performer of the action, we use the active voice; if we want to emphasize the object or target of the action, we express the same thought in the passive. *Студент купил книгу. — Книга куплена студентом.* In the passive construction the performer of the action is expressed by the instrumental case (**студентом**).
The new relations are expressed in Russian by a special form of the verb which is called the short past passive participle (PPP). It is used only as a predicate in passive constructions.
Past passive participles express the idea of a completed action and are almost exclusively formed from perfective transitive verbs.
The passive in the imperfective can be expressed by a transitive verb to which the **-ся** ending has been added. The performer of the action is in the instrumental case:

head: Passive
Active
rows: Эта книга читается всеми. (is read; is being read)

blocks.text: Sometimes the actor is not mentioned. Such constructions can often be expressed by impersonal active constructions with the verb in the 3rd person plural: *Рыба подаётся здесь редко. — Рыбу подают здесь редко. Этот вопрос обсуждался вчера. — Этот вопрос обсуждали вчера.*

head: Imperfective: подписывать
Perfective: подписать
rows: Вчера эти бумаги были подписаны генералом.
Такие бумаги будут и дальше подписываться генералом.
Эти бумаги будут подписаны генералом завтра.
